creative_improvements.idea: Make the FEE BAR (gross/trade > 0.01247) a first-class KPI and run offense at CELL level, not SIGNAL level
creative_improvements.rationale: Measured this run: 30d gross -3.66, fees 7.86, net -11.52 (fees = 215% of gross). 0 of 12 signals with n>=15 clears gross/trade > fee. Only 2 of 11 gross-positive cells (n>=10) clear it. An out-of-sample signal-level kill rule (rank d1-15, kill sub-fee n>=10, test d16-30) retained 4/252 trades - the 'improvement' is entirely from not trading. So signal-level selection is a dead end and the only levers with real magnitude are (a) cell-level concentration and (b) the fee axis (maker entries).
creative_improvements.expected_impact: prevents ~1 wasted signal-kill analysis per week; redirects offense to the fee axis already worth 10-40x any size-mult (#309)

creative_improvements.idea: Stop trying to PREDICT arming at entry - measure it and cut it (per-signal pre-arm deadline)
creative_improvements.rationale: Every entry feature tested (momentum_state, speed_percentile, momentum_score, volume_spike, gap_at_entry, rsi_exec, btc_ema300_position, btc_regime; n=630/30d) lands in a 46-62% arm-rate band with noise nets. Entry-side arming prediction is a dead end. The armed/unarmed split (+19.55 vs -23.21/30d) is an OUTCOME, so the only lever is time: exit when a trade has not touched +0.40% by T. Existing trail_arm_timeout covers 5 signals at T=45-90m; measured T=15-20m is the only band that survives a 15d/15d out-of-sample split.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: T=20m counterfactual delta +4.01/30d in-sample, +2.98/+1.03 same-sign across the two 15d halves (T>=30 flips sign OOS)
creative_improvements.risk: medium (exit-behavior change; shadow-first, 2 signals excluded, substitution fee must be counted)
